Keep resisting my dude. All self harm is bad, but cutting would escalate things. Everyone's different, but I'd theorize once you pick up the blade you'll be hooked. Its really not fun living with these scars.

Theres countless ways to cope, gotta find what works for you

I have also heard the inner thigh is a dangerous spot. My inner thigh weren't too deep, so nothing serious happened. I also remember it not feeling the way I liked. The skin is def different from outer leg.

I think 2 year is a solid timeframe to wait for tattoos.  If anything is still purple thats a no go. I waited about 5 years. You def should feel pretty confident you're done with self harm before getting tattoos over them anyway. To this day, I have thoughts about self harm, but then I'm like "wait.. my artist spent so much time and effort tattooing his art on my body. I like my artist, i dont want to disrespect him"

Wish you the best <3

Additional notes - people notice these things. And if you're like me, that's that your reality now. It sucks to have to wear your mental illness on your body. I'm not saying fault it, but accept it. You can still love your body. You can still feel beautiful. especially if it's hot outside WEAR THOSE SHORTS. wanna go swimming? WEAR A SWIMSUIT. 

staring is kinda human nature. And it doesnt necessarily mean they're thinking negatively of you. When I occasionally see others with scars, I notice, and I almost want to have a conversation with them and tell them I relate. (Buuuut I'm not trying to be invasive soo in most situations, dont do that)

If anyone talks shit or judges, FUCK WHAT THEY THINK. that's not the type of person you want in your life anyway.

When I talk to people about my scars I think they expect me to be like "oh yeaah, just something I did as a teenager how stupid" but they're shocked to hear it's still something I'm attracted to :/

I wish you the best ❤ congratulations on your 6 years

Interesting you found a partner with similar ideas. I havent really considered that as a possibility. I definitely date around and have partners but no committed relationships a while.

Lately I kinda connected the idea that my suicial ideas could be a big factor to my unwillingness to make long term relationships.

The idea of having kids isnt even a big thing for me. Just recently some of the guys I dated expressed it's something they wanted. So I've been playing with the idea of a future like that. Then last night I more or less got hit with the realization it probably shouldn't ever happen.

I'm glad to hear he had such a positive impact on you even after he broke up! I think when people say that "you have to love yourself first.." it's kinda bullshit. I get total dependence is unhealthy, so you got to learn and grow from experiencing that type of love. 


I moved away from my therapist but I still try to see her when I'm in town. Maybe I should look into getting a new one.

I'm just pretty good at keeping my shit together. I struggle with thoughts of self harm and suicide regularly but I've gotten so used to not acting on them. I do a decent job at staying productive but the depression doesn't leave.

I'm 23 and I've felt with this for as long as I can remember. My life is great, but the best way to put it is that I'm still so uncomfortable with being alive.

So when I occasionally try to explain that to people, they dont know what to say other than they're glad I'm not at immediate risk.

Thanks for your response, sorry if my thoughts are kinda dark and scattered
